roadmap.title: Worship’s Rise: start every quest
roadmap.description: Plan four continuous playthroughs on one save for the final achievement. A one-playthrough route uses backup saves for alternate endings, but restoring saves can leave Fallen Feathers locked. In Worship’s Rise, exhaust NPC dialogue and start Nian Suichang, He Youzai and the White-Robed Elder’s quests. Gather this region’s items before the later Zhenwu Altar teleport removes it.

roadmap.title: Cloudspire: preserve the quest chains
roadmap.description: Complete Cloudspire before entering Mt. Zhenwu. Obtain Fang Yao’s Shu Silk Scarf, help Nian at Rebel Camp before crossing the drawbridge, and free Honglan.

roadmap.title: Mt. Zhenwu: finish the side routes
roadmap.description: Agree to help the Elder and summon him for Bo Sorcerer. Visit Ferry Overlook and Bai Mansion before speaking to the Storyteller at Zhenwu Altar. Recheck the first region before accepting his teleport.

roadmap.title: Worship’s Rise in Ruins: keep the true-ending route
roadmap.description: Agree to help the Storyteller in Annalum. Finish Nian’s sword reward, collect both Ring of Samsara halves, and keep them unused. Choose “Remain Silent” with Xuanyangzi to retain the chisel.

roadmap.title: Bo Capital: secret route and first ending
roadmap.description: Return to defeat Zhao Yun before the final riddle. Answer “The wheel turns anew” to reach Shrine Dwelling. Defeat Demon of Obsession and reform causality into the rebirth ring. Finish collections and activate Gate of Truth before entering the final gate with the ring for Dream’s Sweet Deceit.

roadmap.title: Second cycle: correct riddles and Bound by Fate
roadmap.description: Continue the same save into New Game+. Answer all three riddles correctly for Sage. Agree to help the Storyteller and retain the chisel. Finish without the rebirth ring for Bound by Fate’s Threads. Retry Bamboozlings if needed.

roadmap.title: Third cycle: Jarful of Medicine
roadmap.description: Continue the same save. Agree to help the Storyteller in ruined Annalum, give Xuanyangzi the Jade Feather Chisel above Reverent Temple, then defeat the final boss and use the gate.

roadmap.title: Fourth cycle: Successor of the Bo
roadmap.description: Continue the same save. Meet the Red-Clad Lady in Reverent Temple and Doomwillow Beach, then agree at Avian Dwelling. Refuse the Storyteller in ruined Annalum and defeat Bo Magus for the early ending. Finish any remaining achievements for Fallen Feathers.

guide.context: Restoring saves for different endings can leave the final achievement locked even when the ending achievements are unlocked.

steps.text: Finish every other achievement. Keep one continuing save through New Game+ and earn all four endings on that save.
If Fallen Feathers stays locked after restoring an earlier save for endings, complete those endings again through New Game+ on the continuing save.

achievements.description: Reach the Dream’s Sweet Deceit ending.
achievements.summary: Reach the Dream’s Sweet Deceit ending.

guide.context: Complete Cloudspire before Mt. Zhenwu and exhaust the listed NPC dialogues as soon as they become available. Consuming either ring half prevents the final ring from being made on this run.

steps.text: In Worship’s Rise, speak to @npc{He Youzai} on the riverside path after Reverent Temple. Collect the @item{Lost Package} in the grass beyond the upper exit of Tang Palace Maid’s cave at Buddha Cliffs.
After Lightzen Temple, speak to @npc{Nian Suichang} beside the tree on the village approach to receive the @item{Bone Whistle}. Keep the whistle for the later Bo Sorcerer fight.
At Shu Sanctum, speak to the @npc{White-Robed Elder} on the upper-left balcony before leaving the region.
After defeating Great Centipede, give He Youzai the Lost Package on the path toward Doomwillow Beach.
At Doomwillow Beach, turn back from the shrine, take the uphill path slightly right, then turn left to speak to the White-Robed Elder.
After defeating Commander Honglan, speak to He Youzai on Reverent Temple’s ground floor before leaving for Cloudspire.
At Hillswatch, enter the village and take its first left downhill toward the shortcut ladder. Use @mechanic{Examine} at the blue interaction point to obtain the @item{Shu Silk Scarf}.
At Cloudspire Outskirts, speak to the White-Robed Elder on the second level of the tall building behind the shrine.
After Ming General, speak to He Youzai in the tower along Snowpeak Pass. Give the Shu Silk Scarf to @npc{Fang Yao} behind the nearby door guarded by a red-bag enemy.

At Shaft Entrance, agree to help Fang Yao beside the shrine. Collect the @item{Mad Doctor’s Research Note} from the table beneath the entry balcony in the altar room, then show the note and @item{Research Journal – Scrap 1} to He Youzai before Bride’s Boudoir.

After Fang Ling, rest at Wedding Hall and speak to Fang Yao. Finish Cloudspire before entering the Mt. Zhenwu tunnel from Hillswatch. In the tunnel, speak to the White-Robed Elder on the right uphill branch.
As you enter Refugee Camp, speak to Fang Yao and He Youzai beside the fire. Near the entrance and forest ladder, accept the White-Robed Elder’s request for help by selecting “Agree”.

In Avian Marsh, speak to the Elder after the Despair cave. During the Bo Sorcerer battle, blow the Bone Whistle to call him. After winning, rest at Avian Dwelling, cross the tree shortcut and bridge beyond the two frightened humans, and speak to him at the white-flower tomb.

At Zhenwu Altar, avoid the Storyteller until you have taken the boat from Ferry Overlook to Bai Mansion. Speak to He Youzai before Bai Kru, defeat the boss, then show him @item{Research Journal – Scrap 2}.
After the Storyteller sends you to ruined Annalum, speak to Fang Yao and He Youzai outside the arrival building. Agree to help the Storyteller here to keep the full story route open.

At ruined Reverent Temple, speak to Fang Yao behind the shrine for @item{Ring of Samsara – Cause} and @item{Research Journal – Scrap 3}. Upstairs, use these responses with He Youzai: first select “You seem to have forgotten something”, then answer “Not really”. Present “Research Journal – Scrap 3”, and finish with “What’s wrong?”. Receive @item{Ring of Samsara – Effect}. Keep both halves unused.
On the path from the temple toward Burning Cavern, choose “Remain Silent” with @npc{Xuanyangzi} to keep the Jade Feather Chisel.
After reaching Bo Capital, return to the same tomb and defeat @enemy{Eternal Glory – Zhao Yun’s Spirit}. Collect the @item{Cyan Feather Chisel} and @item{Shu Army Board}.
At Depths of the Capital, answer the red gate “The wheel turns anew” only after defeating Zhao Yun. The wrong answer sends you to @loc{Shrine Dwelling}.
Defeat @enemy{Demon of Obsession}, then choose @mechanic{Reform causality} at the altar beyond the boss. This combines the two ring halves into @item{Ring of Samsara – Rebirth}.
Defeat @enemy{Feathery Ambition – Xuanyangzi}. Keep the completed @item{Ring of Samsara – Rebirth} unused. Walk through the final gate while still carrying the ring.

achievements.description: Reach the Successor of the Bo ending.
achievements.summary: Reach the Successor of the Bo ending.

guide.context: This ending stops in region 4. Finish the Bo Capital bosses and collections on an earlier run.

steps.text: Speak to the @npc{Red-Clad Lady} beside the river after Reverent Temple, then by the knocked-down pillar reached from Doomwillow Beach. At Avian Dwelling, speak to her beside the shrine and choose “I agree”.
At ruined Annalum, ask the Storyteller “What kind of favor?”, then choose “I do not…”, followed by “The Bo People…”. Next select “REFUSE TO HELP”, then confirm “REFUSE”.
Take the palace route from Shu Sanctum, defeat Vermilion Feathers Honglan, and continue from Palace Entrance to defeat @enemy{Bo Magus}. The ending triggers immediately.

achievements.description: Unlock the ending named Bound by Fate’s Threads.
achievements.summary: Unlock the ending named Bound by Fate’s Threads.

steps.text: At ruined Annalum, agree to help the Storyteller. On the path above ruined Reverent Temple, choose “Remain Silent” with Xuanyangzi to keep the Jade Feather Chisel.

Defeat @enemy{Feathery Ambition – Xuanyangzi}. Before entering the final gate, make sure you no longer hold @item{Ring of Samsara – Rebirth}. If you made the completed ring, consume it before using the gate.

achievements.description: Reach the Jarful of Medicine ending.
achievements.summary: Reach the Jarful of Medicine ending.

steps.text: Agree to help the Storyteller at ruined Annalum. Above ruined Reverent Temple, speak to Xuanyangzi on the path toward Burning Cavern and choose “Hand over the Jade Feather Chisel”.
Continue to Bo Capital, defeat @enemy{Feathery Ambition – Xuanyangzi}, and use the final gate’s “Enter the Stream of Samsara” option.

achievements.summary: Answer all three red-gate riddles correctly in one playthrough.

guide.context: Get this on the Bound by Fate’s Threads run after finishing the secret-area collections on your first run. A wrong answer autosaves and closes that riddle for the current playthrough; the third correct answer blocks Shrine Dwelling.

collectibles.name: Corpse Pits riddle
collectibles.location: Red gate on the Tang Emperor’s Palace route
collectibles.method: Choose “The winged ascension”.

collectibles.name: Hillswatch riddle
collectibles.location: Across the bridge behind the shrine, on the left
collectibles.method: Choose “Challenge the threads of fate”.

collectibles.name: Depths of the Capital riddle
collectibles.location: Red gate immediately left of the shrine
collectibles.method: Choose “The grand dream fades”.

collectibles.name: Cloudfrost’s Edge
collectibles.location: Opening cave exit
collectibles.method: Receive the sword during the opening cutscene.

collectibles.name: Halberd
collectibles.location: Reverent Temple: path beyond the Boatman’s courtyard
collectibles.method: Loot the corpse on the route through the opened gate.

collectibles.name: Red-Tasseled Spear
collectibles.location: Buddha Cliffs: camp below Tang Palace Maid’s upper exit
collectibles.method: Leave the arena at the top, turn right down the slope, and loot the corpse at the back of the camp.

collectibles.name: Darkfrost Edge
collectibles.location: Lightzen Temple: table among the oil jars
collectibles.method: Take the yellow pickup beside the enemies to the shrine’s right.

collectibles.name: Steampowered Spear
collectibles.location: Panda merchant’s cave beyond Lightzen Temple
collectibles.method: Trade one Bamboo Shoot to the Panda. At the staircase after the river, follow the right path past the house and stone bridge to the cave.

collectibles.name: Un-Equilibrium Blades
collectibles.location: Riverside house below the invisible bridge toward Shu Sanctum
collectibles.method: Cross the bridge near the red-eyed enemy, turn left along the river, and collect the weapon by the cart where an enemy breaks through a door.

collectibles.name: Empyrean Greataxe
collectibles.location: Village roof above the fire bird near Annalum
collectibles.method: Take the uphill bamboo-forest path. Cross the roofs beside the boulder thrower, then use the last house’s stairs and ladder to reach the roof above the fire bird.

collectibles.name: Firearm Blades
collectibles.location: Village beyond Shu Sanctum’s right shortcut door
collectibles.method: Open the door from the Lu Hongliu side and follow the path to its end among the pickaxe enemies.

collectibles.name: Lashing Whip
collectibles.location: Mercury Workshop: first right exit from the red tree
collectibles.method: Collect the weapon between the two small gun enemies.

collectibles.name: Astral Blade
collectibles.location: Bandit Cave
collectibles.method: Defeat Great Centipede and collect its reward.

collectibles.name: Gunpowder Spear
collectibles.location: Cloudspire Outskirts: roof of the tall building behind the shrine
collectibles.method: Climb the ladders outside the building and open the rooftop chest.

collectibles.name: Twin Bandits
collectibles.location: Cloudspire Outskirts: behind the red-eyed enemy near the second corruption pillar
collectibles.method: Climb the small house’s ladder on the uphill snowy path. At the pillar, take two right turns through the big gate and open the chest behind the boxes.

collectibles.name: Flamebringer
collectibles.location: Rebel Camp
collectibles.method: Defeat Ai Nengqi before crossing the drawbridge and collect the weapon.

collectibles.name: Boreal Abyss
collectibles.location: Snowfall Palace: hidden room beneath the elevator
collectibles.method: Climb the central stairs and follow the right building to the archer’s elevator room. Send the lift upward, then use its central pressure plate to descend into the lower treasure room. Open the chest.

collectibles.name: Bitter Severance
collectibles.location: Wedding Hall
collectibles.method: Defeat Fang Ling and collect the weapon.

collectibles.name: Thunder’s Call
collectibles.location: Zhenwu Antechamber
collectibles.method: Defeat South General Liu Wenxiu and collect the weapon.

collectibles.name: Cloudpiercer
collectibles.location: Temple reached by the scaffolding after Liu Wenxiu
collectibles.method: Stay on the temple’s entry floor, take the stairs down, then descend the long ladder. Open the chest by the two bird enemies.

collectibles.name: Cinder Dragoncoil
collectibles.location: Pavilion of Knowledge: upper corridor
collectibles.method: Climb upstairs from the shrine, turn left, and open the chest before leaving the cave.

collectibles.name: Serpent Fang
collectibles.location: Ferry Overlook: left dock
collectibles.method: Speak to Li Dinggou and Sun Kewang in Hillswatch. In Avian Marsh, collect the Secret Letter inside the tree hollow, on the right before the two humanoid bird enemies. Give this letter to Li Dinggou at Zhenwu Antechamber. At Ferry Overlook’s left dock, exhaust both men’s dialogue, rest, and collect the weapon.
collectibles.note: If Li Dinggou is hostile at the dock, defeat him, rest, speak to Sun Kewang, then rest again and collect the weapon.

collectibles.name: Li Jiao’s Fang
collectibles.location: Ferry Overlook: Boatman’s dock
collectibles.method: Speak to the Boatman, visit Bai Mansion, and defeat Bai Kru. Return to the Boatman for the weapon.

collectibles.name: Zhanlu Sword
collectibles.location: Shu Sanctum: cliff above the roof route
collectibles.method:
1. Speak to Nian Suichang beside the tree after Lightzen Temple, then beside Shu Sanctum’s shrine. After Lu Bingzhang, give Nian the Mercurial Blood. Visit him beside the injured man at Reverent Temple.

2. After Commander Honglan, speak to Nian at Reverent Temple before unlocking the Cloudspire courtyard door, then again after opening it.

3. At Hillswatch, speak to Nian before meeting Li Dinggou and Sun Kewang. Collect the Tattered Pack in the grass by the archer beyond their tower. Return the pack to Nian and choose “Remain Silent”.

4. At Rebel Camp, speak to Nian beside Ai Nengqi’s arena door. Summon him with the Bone Whistle during that fight, then speak to him after winning. Do this before crossing the Cloudspire drawbridge.

5. At Refugee Camp, choose “Remain Silent” with Nian by the vendors’ fire. After Bo Sorcerer, take the exit from the arena, then two right turns to find Nian by the bridge back into camp. Speak to him.

6. After Liu Wenxiu, climb the scaffolding and take the left route toward Refugee Camp’s shortcut door. Speak to Nian before that door. After Zhang Xianzhong, meet Nian by the fire at Zhenwu Altar before the Storyteller’s teleport.

7. In ruined Shu Sanctum, follow the roof route uphill past the boulder thrower. At the cliff, collect the pickup behind Nian and speak to him. Rest at a shrine, then return to collect the sword.
collectibles.note: If you exposed Nian at Hillswatch, he is hostile at the final cliff. Defeat him to obtain the same sword.

collectibles.name: Scorn Greataxe
collectibles.location: Shu Sanctum: wooden hut before the tunnel on the lower palace path
collectibles.method: Leave via the roof, climb past the boulder thrower, and take the right descent over wooden platforms. Open the hut’s chest.

collectibles.name: Malice Sting
collectibles.location: Tao Qing’s shop after its final upgrade
collectibles.method: Give Tao Qing all 17 stock items, including Zhao Yun’s Shu Army Board, then buy the spear.

collectibles.name: Plumed Grace
collectibles.location: The Forbidden Lands
collectibles.method: Defeat Xuanyangzi and collect the weapon.

guide.context: Complete the White-Robed Elder’s meetings under Eternal Glory – Zhao Yun’s Spirit before defeating Bo Sorcerer. Those meetings are needed for the Tigraliz Pendant.

collectibles.name: Gourd Pendant
collectibles.location: River path after Reverent Temple
collectibles.method: Defeat the shield enemy at the top of the small hill.

collectibles.name: Entwined Legend Pendant
collectibles.location: Buddha Cliffs: dead-end opposite Lightzen Temple village
collectibles.method: Take the right branch before the village and collect the pickup beyond the tripwires and two enemies.

collectibles.name: Monkey Pendant
collectibles.location: Lightzen Temple: first house on the left
collectibles.method: Collect the yellow pickup inside; two enemies drop from the ceiling.

collectibles.name: Luduan Pendant
collectibles.location: Reverent Temple: Yu Xia
collectibles.method: Collect the Bloodstained Letter on Shu Sanctum’s top floor on the way to Lu Bingzhang. Rest, return to Reverent Temple, and give it to Yu Xia in white before the shrine.

collectibles.name: Pixiu Pendant
collectibles.location: Annalum: downhill behind the courtyard building
collectibles.method: From the fire bird before Lu Hongliu, take the left descent to Annalum. Search the courtyard’s back-left path and open the chest at the bottom.

collectibles.name: Fiend-Felling Pendant
collectibles.location: Tao Qing at Shu Sanctum
collectibles.method: Give him Lu Hongliu’s Jade Cicada, then buy the pendant.

collectibles.name: Dracolich Pendant
collectibles.location: Mercury Workshop: upper red-tree level beyond two spike traps
collectibles.method: Drop from the tree’s left path to the lower ledge, enter the cave, and climb its ladder. Cross the spike room, circle the upper tree past three large enemies, and open the small chest beyond the next spikes.

collectibles.name: Phoenix Pendant
collectibles.location: Mercury Workshop: behind the locked gate near the tree’s bottom
collectibles.method: Drop onto the tree branch right of the locked gate from the blue pickup above. Follow the monks’ path behind the gate and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Twin Infant Pendant
collectibles.location: Mercury Workshop: altar beneath the red tree
collectibles.method: Descend to the bottom past the screamer pods and collect the pendant beside the Lost Remains.

collectibles.name: Bird Pendant
collectibles.location: Tao Qing at Shu Sanctum
collectibles.method: Give him Great Centipede’s Believer’s Statue, then buy the pendant.

collectibles.name: Lifesteal Pendant
collectibles.location: Tao Qing at Shu Sanctum
collectibles.method: Give him Soulwood’s Alltree Jade Cylinder, then buy the pendant.

collectibles.name: Eagle Pendant
collectibles.location: Tang Emperor’s Palace: dead-end ahead from the entrance
collectibles.method: Keep straight instead of climbing the roofs. Open the small chest guarded by two enemies.

collectibles.name: Child’s Hope Pendant
collectibles.location: Cloudspire Outskirts: cave behind the yellow gate by the shortcut
collectibles.method: Open the Benediction Gate beside the shrine’s right shortcut gate and collect the pendant near the giant tree enemy.

collectibles.name: Bravery Pendant
collectibles.location: Rebel Camp: tent behind the shrine
collectibles.method: Open the small chest in the tent.

collectibles.name: Dragonling Pendant
collectibles.location: Snowfall Palace: left room above the shrine’s right stairs
collectibles.method: Open the chest in front of the flute-playing enemy.

collectibles.name: Crimson Pendant
collectibles.location: Shaft Entrance: top of the rolling-boulder tunnel ladder
collectibles.method: Collect the pendant beside the wall switch on the main route.

collectibles.name: Coiled Dragon Pendant
collectibles.location: Bride’s Boudoir: Honglan’s cell
collectibles.method: Defeat the red-clothed guard in the next room for the Dungeon Key. Give the key to Honglan.

collectibles.name: Dragon-Fish Pendant
collectibles.location: Bride’s Boudoir: table just beyond Honglan’s cell
collectibles.method: Use the Examine gesture at the blue interaction point on the table.

collectibles.name: Pearl Pendant
collectibles.location: Avian Marsh: lower path before the giant clam
collectibles.method: Stay low from the shrine and follow the path to the right; collect the pendant before the clam emerges.

collectibles.name: Crane Pendant
collectibles.location: Avian Marsh: exit of the Despair summoners’ cave
collectibles.method: Open the small chest on the right beside the armored enemy near the exit.

collectibles.name: Tigraliz Pendant
collectibles.location: Avian Dwelling: white-flower tomb
collectibles.method: Complete the Elder’s early meetings, agree to help at Refugee Camp, and summon him for Bo Sorcerer. Rest, then speak to him at the tomb across the bridge from the two frightened humans.

collectibles.name: Peace Pendant
collectibles.location: Tao Qing at Refugee Camp
collectibles.method: Give him Bo Sorcerer’s Copper Drum, then buy the pendant.

collectibles.name: Thunder Pendant
collectibles.location: Main Rebel Camp: large tent near the entrance
collectibles.method: Open the small pale chest before climbing toward Zhenwu Antechamber.

collectibles.name: Demon Pendant
collectibles.location: Zhenwu Antechamber: statue below the roof opening
collectibles.method: After opening the shrine shortcuts, follow the next area’s right wall to the roof ladder. Drop through the opening onto the statue and collect the pendant.

collectibles.name: Tiger Pendant
collectibles.location: Ferry Overlook: far end of the left dock
collectibles.method: Look behind the objects at the dock’s end and take the pendant.

collectibles.name: Kylin Pendant
collectibles.location: Tao Qing at Refugee Camp
collectibles.method: Give him Bai Kru’s Ivory Seal, then buy the pendant.

collectibles.name: Sun Pendant
collectibles.location: Palace route: small wood beyond the fighting monsters
collectibles.method: From Shu Sanctum’s roof route, climb past the boulder thrower and descend right toward the palace. Pass the yellow totem, take the right route beyond the fighting monsters, and open the chest by the bird enemy and another totem.

collectibles.name: Twin Lion Pendant
collectibles.location: Palace Pass: room opposite the shrine
collectibles.method: Open the door opposite the shrine and the chest behind the red-eyed enemy.

collectibles.name: Wishborn Pendant
collectibles.location: Reverent Temple: wooden bridge behind the shrine
collectibles.method: Collect the yellow pickup where the young boy stood earlier.

collectibles.name: Nameless Eye
collectibles.location: Capital Entrance: cauldron at the right-hand dead-end
collectibles.method: Climb the stairs on the shrine’s right. Use Worship at the blue point before the cauldron guarded by a red-eyed enemy.

collectibles.name: Unknown Meat
collectibles.location: The Forbidden Lands
collectibles.method: Defeat Xuanyangzi and collect the pendant.

steps.text: Palace Hill: collect the Buddha Statue behind the boxes on the left path. Use the statue beside the NPC on the right path to drain the palace, then climb down into the exposed arena. Defeat @enemy{Commander - Honglan}.

achievements.description: Defeat Eternal Glory – Zhao Yun’s Spirit.
achievements.summary: Defeat Eternal Glory – Zhao Yun’s Spirit.

guide.context: Finish each earlier meeting before advancing to the next region. Speak until the Elder has no new dialogue; skipped meetings can end his quest.

steps.text: Speak to the @npc{White-Robed Elder} on Shu Sanctum’s upper-left balcony, then on the uphill path from Doomwillow Beach.

In Cloudspire, speak to him on the second level of the building behind Cloudspire Outskirts. Finish Cloudspire before entering the Mt. Zhenwu tunnel from Hillswatch; speak to him on the tunnel’s right uphill branch.
At Refugee Camp, choose “Agree” when he requests help. Speak to him again after the Despair cave in Avian Marsh.

During the @enemy{Bo Sorcerer} battle, blow the @item{Bone Whistle} to call the Elder. After winning, rest and speak to him at the white-flower tomb across the bridge from Avian Dwelling to receive the Tigraliz Pendant.
After reaching Bo Capital, return to the same tomb and defeat @enemy{Eternal Glory – Zhao Yun’s Spirit}. Collect the @item{Cyan Feather Chisel} and @item{Shu Army Board}.
Bride’s Boudoir: continue past the prison to the wooden bridge after the elevator shortcut. The bridge drops you into Fang Ling’s arena. Defeat @enemy{Perfect Bride - Fang Ling}.
Altar Gate: enter the large gate to the right of the shrine. Defeat @enemy{Sovereign - Zhang Xianzhong's Obsession}.

achievements.description: Defeat Dragon Emperor - Zhu Youjian's Obsession.
achievements.summary: Defeat Dragon Emperor - Zhu Youjian's Obsession.

guide.context: Refuse the Storyteller’s offer in ruined Annalum only on your Successor of the Bo run; that ending stops the story before this boss.

steps.text: Burning Cavern: follow the cave past the shrine to its end.
Defeat @enemy{Dragon Emperor - Zhu Youjian's Obsession}.

guide.context: Refuse the Storyteller’s offer in ruined Annalum only on your Successor of the Bo run; that ending stops the story before this boss.

steps.text: The Forbidden Lands: enter the door to the left of the shrine.
Defeat @enemy{Feathery Ambition - Xuanyangzi}.

guide.context: Giving the correct answer at the final red gate closes the Shrine Dwelling route for this playthrough.

steps.text: Follow the Fang Yao, He Youzai, and White-Robed Elder steps under Dream’s Sweet Deceit. Keep both Ring of Samsara halves and the Jade Feather Chisel; defeat Zhao Yun after reaching Bo Capital.
At the red gate beside Depths of the Capital, choose “The wheel turns anew” to reach Shrine Dwelling. Defeat @enemy{Demon of Obsession} there.
After Zhenwu Altar, leave the Storyteller alone and enter the cave behind him. At Ferry Overlook, take the boat to Bai Mansion and follow the path left of its shrine into the cave.
Defeat @enemy{Monstrous Toddler - Bai Kru}.

achievements.summary: Fully upgrade the Manna Vase’s capacity with 12 Forgotten Remembrances.

guide.context: Spend the Forgotten Remembrances on all Manna Vase capacity nodes in the left skill-tree branch at a shrine. Collecting the chests alone does not finish the upgrade.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Remembrance 1
collectibles.location: Buddha Cliffs: riverside below Tang Palace Maid’s arena
collectibles.method: Take the lower exit from the arena and open the golden chest by the river.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Remembrance 2
collectibles.location: Doomwillow Beach: left path behind the Red-Clad Lady
collectibles.method: From the shrine, turn back toward the blood pool, go left past the attacking tree, and climb the ladder. Cross the knocked-down pillar, descend behind the Lady, and open the chest on the left.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Remembrance 3
collectibles.location: Cloudspire Outskirts: tower above the second corruption pillar
collectibles.method: Follow the uphill snowy path behind the shrine, climb the small house’s ladder, then climb the tall tower and open its rooftop chest.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Remembrance 4
collectibles.location: Cloudspire City: building before the snowy descent to Snowfall Palace
collectibles.method: At the red-bag enemy’s rooftop, cross the scaffolding into the next building. Stay inside and descend its stairs, cross the bridge, and open the chest at the bottom of the opposite building.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Remembrance 5
collectibles.location: Shaft Entrance: gold-filled room behind the shortcut door
collectibles.method: Drop right from the swinging-club path and follow the lower route to the shortcut door. Open the golden chest in the gold-filled room.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Remembrance 6
collectibles.location: Avian Marsh: central platform in the Despair cave
collectibles.method: Circle left into the second summoner’s room. From its lower floor, drop through the window onto the platforms and cross to the golden chest.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Remembrance 7
collectibles.location: Zhenwu Antechamber: third tower on the main route
collectibles.method: After passing the dancing fire bird and climbing the long ladder, cross to the third tower. Open the chest on the floor with another dancing bird.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Remembrance 8
collectibles.location: Zhenwu Antechamber: behind the upper Benediction Gate
collectibles.method: After Liu Wenxiu, climb the scaffolding and cross the lever platforms to the elevator. Cross the invisible floor marked by floating orbs beside it and open the gate to reach the chest.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Remembrance 9
collectibles.location: Shu Sanctum: broken house before the bamboo forest
collectibles.method: Leave the shrine building, cross the invisible bridge, and enter the broken house on the village’s right. Open the golden chest.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Remembrance 10
collectibles.location: Annalum Courtyard: directly before the shrine
collectibles.method: From Shu Sanctum’s roof, climb the right path past the boulder thrower to the hilltop. Cross the invisible bridge and open the chest before the shrine.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Remembrance 11
collectibles.location: Palace Entrance: lower floor of the Underground Palace tower
collectibles.method: Take the left path but stop before the central ladder. Drop one level outside the tower, climb the short wooden ramp by the giant enemy, enter the tower, and drop to the chest.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Remembrance 12
collectibles.location: Depths of the Capital: corner behind the red bird monster
collectibles.method: Turn back from the shrine, take the left path, and keep left past the large red bird. Open the golden chest in the corner.

achievements.summary: Fully upgrade the Manna Vase’s healing potency with 10 Lost Remains.

guide.context: Spend the Lost Remains on all Manna Vase potency nodes in the left skill-tree branch at a shrine.

collectibles.name: Lost Remains 1
collectibles.location: Lightzen Temple: courtyard to the shrine’s right
collectibles.method: Open the large golden chest beside the monk feeding on a corpse.

collectibles.name: Lost Remains 2
collectibles.location: Mercury Workshop: altar beneath the red tree
collectibles.method: Descend the tree to the bottom and pass the screamer pods. Open the golden chest beside the Twin Infant Pendant.

collectibles.name: Lost Remains 3
collectibles.location: Palace Hill: temple below the approach ladder
collectibles.method: Climb down the ladder from the shrine, enter the attached temple, defeat Tang Palace Maid, and open the golden chest.

collectibles.name: Lost Remains 4
collectibles.location: Snowy Passage: large tent on the left uphill route
collectibles.method: Enter the tent guarded by the giant shield enemy and open the golden chest.

collectibles.name: Lost Remains 5
collectibles.location: Shaft Entrance: room below the first rolling-boulder hall
collectibles.method: Cross the swinging clubs on the left route. Wait for two boulders, then drop from the ledge where they fell and open the chest below.

collectibles.name: Lost Remains 6
collectibles.location: Battlefield Pass: wooden balcony beside the blood-filled Despair cave
collectibles.method: Turn right from the shrine, then follow the left path into the summoner’s cave. Take the right exit onto the fenced platform and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Lost Remains 7
collectibles.location: Avian Marsh: tree interior below the two frightened humans
collectibles.method: After the Despair cave and tree village, pass the shortcut ladder and climb the hollow tree. Take the right path beside the two humans and climb down the left ladder to the chest.

collectibles.name: Lost Remains 8
collectibles.location: Zhenwu Antechamber: barred chamber below the towers
collectibles.method: From the third tower containing Forgotten Remembrance 7, enter the next tower, descend its stairs and ladder, and open the chest behind the bars.

collectibles.name: Lost Remains 9
collectibles.location: Burning Cavern: right side near the entrance
collectibles.method: Open the golden chest in the cave before the boss.

collectibles.name: Lost Remains 10
collectibles.location: Depths of the Capital: beneath the Storyteller’s Benediction room
collectibles.method: Pull the yellow lever left of the shrine to open two routes. Facing the laser dragon, take the left gate and ride the elevator. Turn left toward the Despair skull, then right onto the red root. Drop to the lever below the root and pull it. Return above, pass the three praying enemies, and cross the new bridge to the yellow gate. Inside, descend the narrow path before the Storyteller and turn left for the chest; do not drop down by the bird.

achievements.description: Enhance a weapon to the maximum

steps.text: At a shrine, buy the chosen weapon’s upgrade nodes through +9 using Faint, Brilliant, and Radiant Red Feathers. Wu Gang sells these after his stock upgrades.

For the final Lustrous Red Feather, enter the cave behind and slightly left of Capital Entrance, take the elevator, and climb the white tree’s large root beside the fighting monsters. Collect the feather at the top and buy the +10 upgrade at a shrine.

achievements.summary: Make a blood offering at a shrine.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Offer Blood} at the first shrine.
Obtain @item{Cloudfrost’s Edge} after the opening cave cutscene to learn @mechanic{Blink Kick}.
Lightzen Temple: open the large courtyard gate on the shrine’s right. Defeat @enemy{Master Raider - Man-eating Dhutanga}.
Bandit Cave: follow the descending path into the large chamber after the shrine. Defeat @enemy{Blightweaver - Great Centipede}.

From Shu Sanctum, cross the invisible river bridge and follow the river into the bamboo forest. Take the uphill path through the village, cross the rooftops by the boulder-throwing enemy, and pass the fire bird to the large wooden boss gate.
Defeat @enemy{Gluttonous Monstrosity - Lu Hongliu}.

Lu Mansion: take the elevator, follow the blood pools and ladder, then knock down the shortcut pillar. Follow the descending path and turn right toward the growling boss. Defeat @enemy{Reborn Treant - Soulwood}.
Shu Sanctum: climb to the top floor above the shrine. Defeat @enemy{Feathered Priest - Lu Bingzhang}.

achievements.displayName: General of the North - Ai Nengqi
achievements.description: Beat General of the North - Ai Nengqi.
achievements.summary: Beat General of the North - Ai Nengqi.

guide.context: Fight Ai Nengqi before crossing the Cloudspire drawbridge; bypassing him can end Nian Suichang’s quest.

steps.text: Rebel Camp: kill the armored soldier in front of the shrine for the Rebel Camp Key. Climb down the ladder on the left, take the left path, and unlock the arena gate.
Beat @enemy{General of the North - Ai Nengqi}.

Cloudspire Outskirts: cross the lowered drawbridge to reach the arena. Defeating Ai Nengqi lowers the bridge; lighting all three signal fires also opens the route. Defeat @enemy{Ming General - Liu Cheng'en}.

achievements.displayName: Mistress of the Night - Huang Yan
achievements.description: Beat Mistress of the Night - Huang Yan.
achievements.summary: Beat Mistress of the Night - Huang Yan.

steps.text: Snowfall Palace: take the path on the right before the main staircase, enter the door, ride the elevator down, and open the large gate. Beat @enemy{Mistress of the Night - Huang Yan}.
Zhenwu Antechamber: open the shortcut door behind the shrine from the far side, then go through it and climb the stairs on the right. Defeat @enemy{South General - Liu Wenxiu}.

guide.context: For the White-Robed Elder’s quest, agree to help him at Refugee Camp and speak to him after the Despair cave in Avian Marsh. Summon him here with the Bone Whistle before defeating the boss.

steps.text: Avian Marsh: continue through the tree village to the boss. Kick down the tree shortcut to Avian Dwelling for return visits.
Defeat @enemy{Bo Sorcerer}.
Palace Pass: take the descending path on the left into the arena.
Defeat @enemy{Vermilion Feathers - Honglan}.
Palace Entrance: follow the left path and climb down the ladder to the arena.
Defeat @enemy{Bo Magus}.

achievements.description: Summon an NPC to aid you
achievements.summary: Use the Bone Whistle to summon an NPC during a boss fight.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Nian Suichang} beside the tree after Lightzen Temple to receive the @item{Bone Whistle}. Speak to him again beside Shu Sanctum’s shrine.
Use the Bone Whistle during the @enemy{Feathered Priest – Lu Bingzhang} fight upstairs in Shu Sanctum.

If Lu Bingzhang is already defeated, use the White-Robed Elder instead: complete his early meetings under Eternal Glory – Zhao Yun’s Spirit, agree to help at Refugee Camp, speak to him after Avian Marsh’s Despair cave, and blow the Bone Whistle during Bo Sorcerer.

guide.context: If a Bamboozling escapes, rest at a shrine to respawn it. Attack quickly with a spell or a fast sword strike. If the achievement stays locked after this route, continue defeating Bamboozlings in New Game+ on the same save.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 1
collectibles.location: Lightzen Temple: beyond the gate opened with the boss key
collectibles.method: Unlock the gate facing the shrine using Dhutanga’s key and kill the fleeing Bamboozling on the path.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 2
collectibles.location: Lightzen Temple: path before the Storyteller and Panda cave
collectibles.method: After the river, take the right path at the staircase. Continue straight past the stone bridge and attack before the Bamboozling reaches the cave.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 3
collectibles.location: Village courtyard on the Shu Sanctum–Annalum route
collectibles.method: Cross Shu Sanctum’s invisible bridge and follow the river through the bamboo forest. Climb through the village by the boulder thrower. At the fire bird, take the left route through the second house to the rear courtyard.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 4
collectibles.location: Mercury Workshop: top of the red tree
collectibles.method: Drop from the tree’s left path into the lower cave, climb its ladder, and cross the spike room. Turn right along the upper tree and attack before the next spike corridor.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 5
collectibles.location: Doomwillow Beach: right dead-end behind the Red-Clad Lady
collectibles.method: Follow the blood pool’s left route past the attacking tree, climb the ladder, and cross the pillar shortcut. Descend behind the Lady and turn right.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 6
collectibles.location: Palace Hill: left path beside the shrine
collectibles.method: Attack the fleeing Bamboozling on the left path.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 7
collectibles.location: Cloudspire Outskirts: snowy route to the drawbridge
collectibles.method: Search near the third corruption pillar, between the shrine’s shortcut gate and Liu Cheng’en’s bridge.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 8
collectibles.location: Rebel Camp: elevator in front of the two cannons
collectibles.method: Climb down the shrine’s left ladder. Attack the Bamboozling between the two mines before the elevator.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 9
collectibles.location: Snowfall Palace: dead-end left of the main staircase
collectibles.method: Enter the alcove beside the large stairs and attack the Bamboozling.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 10
collectibles.location: Shaft Entrance: lower route before the large corruption spider
collectibles.method: Drop right from the swinging-club path and follow the route toward the spider.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 11
collectibles.location: Avian Marsh: lower nest beneath the Aurum Bird
collectibles.method: Climb the shrine’s shortcut ladder, turn right past the large walking bird, and follow the uphill path to an Aurum Bird and burned nest. Loot the nest to fall to the Bamboozling; on retries, drop from the same spot beside the bird and corpse.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 12
collectibles.location: Avian Dwelling: bridge beyond the two frightened humans
collectibles.method: Cross the knocked-down tree shortcut from the shrine, go straight past the humans, and attack the Bamboozling on the small bridge.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 13
collectibles.location: Zhenwu Antechamber: rooftop bridge facing two cannons
collectibles.method: Descend the shrine’s approach stairs, cross through the left tower to the right tower, and climb its ladder. Cross the rooftop bridge and attack the Bamboozling fleeing right toward the cannons.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 14
collectibles.location: Annalum Courtyard: beside the invisible hilltop bridge
collectibles.method: From Shu Sanctum’s roof, climb past the boulder thrower to the hilltop and cross the invisible bridge toward the shrine.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 15
collectibles.location: Palace Vegetable Garden route: forest edge beside the red pond
collectibles.method: Continue through the palace past the fighting monsters and attack at the start of the forest.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 16
collectibles.location: Palace route: red vine bridge toward Palace Pass
collectibles.method: Follow the forest route from the red pond and attack on top of the vine bridge.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 17
collectibles.location: Reverent Temple: bamboo forest outside the courtyard gate
collectibles.method: Leave the courtyard toward Shu Sanctum and climb the forest path. Attack before the Bamboozling reaches the two fighting enemies.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 18
collectibles.location: Capital Entrance: bone bridge after the second corruption head
collectibles.method: Follow the shrine’s left route, disable the second head, and pass the elevator shortcut to the bridge.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 19
collectibles.location: Depths of the Capital: route beyond the yellow lever’s right gate
collectibles.method: Pull the lever left of the shrine. Facing the laser dragon, take the right gate and attack on the path to the Benediction Gate.

collectibles.name: Bamboozling 20
collectibles.location: Shrine Dwelling: stairs on the right-hand route
collectibles.method: Answer “The wheel turns anew” at the red gate beside Depths of the Capital. In the hidden area, follow the right path and attack the fleeing Bamboozling on the stairs.

achievements.summary: Defeat the six Inner Demons found at fixed locations.

guide.context: The demon created when you die at maximum Madness does not count. These six encounters drop Bo Blood.

collectibles.name: Annalum Inner Demon
collectibles.location: Pagoda at the courtyard’s back-left descent
collectibles.method: Enter the courtyard beside the shrine and descend the back-left path toward the pendant chest to make the demon appear. Defeat it.

collectibles.name: Lu Mansion Inner Demon
collectibles.location: Bottom of the shrine elevator
collectibles.method: Ride the elevator down and approach the two tree enemies to spawn the demon. Defeat it.

collectibles.name: Cloudspire Outskirts Inner Demon
collectibles.location: Burning house beyond the second corruption pillar
collectibles.method: Take the uphill snowy route behind the shrine and climb the small house’s ladder. At the pillar, turn left, pass the cannon, and approach the burning house. Defeat the demon.

collectibles.name: Snowfall Palace Inner Demon
collectibles.location: Hidden treasure room beneath the elevator
collectibles.method: Climb the central stairs and take the right route to the archer’s elevator room. Send the lift up, then use its pressure plate to descend to the lower treasure room. Defeat the demon that appears by the weapon chest.

collectibles.name: Refugee Camp Inner Demon
collectibles.location: Back of the swamp beyond the shrine exit
collectibles.method: Pass the bird enemy at the swamp entrance and approach the far side to spawn the demon. Defeat it.

collectibles.name: Avian Marsh Inner Demon
collectibles.location: Lower area below the burned branch before a summoner
collectibles.method: From the shrine, climb the left slope beside the clam and follow the tree toward the grey burned branch. Pick up its item to fall to the demon; if the branch is gone, drop from the same spot. Defeat the demon.

achievements.summary: Open all seven yellow Benediction Gates.

guide.context: Yellow Benediction Gates open with the chisel. The three red riddle gates do not count.

collectibles.name: Cloudspire Outskirts gate
collectibles.location: Beside the right-hand shortcut gate near the shrine
collectibles.method: From the shrine’s uphill snowy route, climb the small house’s ladder to the second corruption pillar. Take two right turns through the large gate, continue to the cannons, and descend right to the shortcut. Open the yellow gate beside it.

collectibles.name: Zhenwu Antechamber gate
collectibles.location: Invisible floor beside the upper elevator
collectibles.method: After Liu Wenxiu, climb the scaffolding and cross the lever platforms to the elevator. Follow the floating orbs across the invisible floor and open the yellow gate.

collectibles.name: Palace Vegetable Garden gate
collectibles.location: Stairs behind the glowing palace pillar
collectibles.method: From Shu Sanctum’s roof, climb past the boulder thrower, then descend right toward the palace. Climb the stairs behind the glowing pillar beside the large enemy and open the gate at the path’s end.

collectibles.name: Capital Entrance gate
collectibles.location: Dead-end left of the tall white tree
collectibles.method: Enter the cave behind and slightly left of the shrine, then ride the elevator. Climb the stairs left of the white tree and drop into the dead-end by the large monster. Open the gate from this side.

collectibles.name: Depths right-route gate
collectibles.location: Beyond the first yellow lever’s right gate
collectibles.method: Take the left route from the shrine and pull the yellow lever. Facing the laser dragon, take the right opened gate, pass the Bamboozling, and open the yellow gate.

collectibles.name: Invisible-bridge cave gate
collectibles.location: Cave off the red roots above Depths of the Capital
collectibles.method: At the first yellow lever, face the dragon and take the left opened gate to the elevator. Above, turn right and pull the next lever. Cross the new platforms, turn left at the grey bird, and follow the red roots. Cross the invisible bridge marked by orbs on the right. Inside the cave, turn right and open the gate.

collectibles.name: Storyteller gate
collectibles.location: Bridge beyond the three praying enemies above Depths of the Capital
collectibles.method: Return to the elevator’s upper area. Take the left route toward the Despair skull, then climb right onto the red root. Drop from the root to a lever and pull it. Return above and continue past the three praying enemies. Cross the newly formed bridge to the Panda and open the yellow gate.

achievements.description: Unlock Tao Qing’s full stock with all 17 shop upgrades.
achievements.summary: Unlock Tao Qing’s full stock with all 17 shop upgrades.

guide.context: Tao Qing first trades at Shu Sanctum, later at Refugee Camp and ruined Annalum. Give him each stock item; buying his goods is not required. Complete the White-Robed Elder’s quest under Eternal Glory – Zhao Yun’s Spirit to obtain the final item.

collectibles.name: Copper Jar
collectibles.location: Lightzen Temple
collectibles.method: Defeat Master Raider – Man-eating Dhutanga and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Priest’s Broken Cane
collectibles.location: Shu Sanctum
collectibles.method: Defeat Feathered Priest – Lu Bingzhang and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Scenic Painting
collectibles.location: Annalum
collectibles.method: From Annalum’s courtyard, cross the bridge on the right and defeat the red-eyed enemy. Give its Scenic Painting to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Jade Cicada
collectibles.location: Annalum
collectibles.method: Defeat Gluttonous Monstrosity – Lu Hongliu and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Believer’s Statue
collectibles.location: Bandit Cave
collectibles.method: Defeat Blightweaver – Great Centipede and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Alltree Jade Cylinder
collectibles.location: Lu Mansion
collectibles.method: Defeat Reborn Treant – Soulwood and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Seven Treasure Rosary
collectibles.location: Rebel Camp
collectibles.method: Beat General of the North – Ai Nengqi and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Wooden Strip
collectibles.location: Snowpeak Pass
collectibles.method: Defeat Ming General – Liu Cheng’en and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Shell Cup
collectibles.location: Snowfall Palace
collectibles.method: Beat Mistress of the Night – Huang Yan and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Shu Silk Fan
collectibles.location: Wedding Hall
collectibles.method: Defeat Perfect Bride – Fang Ling and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Copper Drum
collectibles.location: Avian Dwelling
collectibles.method: Defeat Bo Sorcerer and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Tortoise Ingot
collectibles.location: Altar Gate
collectibles.method: Defeat Sovereign – Zhang Xianzhong’s Obsession and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Ivory Seal
collectibles.location: Bai Mansion
collectibles.method: Defeat Monstrous Toddler – Bai Kru and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Ice Crystal
collectibles.location: Palace Pass
collectibles.method: Defeat Vermilion Feathers – Honglan and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Magus’ Eyepiece
collectibles.location: Palace Entrance
collectibles.method: Defeat Bo Magus and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Jade Belt Hook
collectibles.location: Burning Cavern
collectibles.method: Defeat Dragon Emperor – Zhu Youjian’s Obsession and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

collectibles.name: Shu Army Board
collectibles.location: Return to the Mt. Zhenwu tomb
collectibles.method: Defeat Eternal Glory – Zhao Yun’s Spirit and give the stock item to Tao Qing.

achievements.description: Fully unlock all of Wu Gang's stock
achievements.summary: Unlock Wu Gang’s full stock with all nine shop upgrades.

guide.context: Wu Gang first trades at Shu Sanctum, then Refugee Camp and ruined Annalum. Give him each stock item; buying the stock is unnecessary.

collectibles.name: Golden Bowl
collectibles.location: Lightzen Temple: building before Dhutanga’s arena gate
collectibles.method: Take the purple pickup inside the building, then give it to Wu Gang.

collectibles.name: Incense Burner
collectibles.location: Corpse Pits: statue at the bamboo forest entrance
collectibles.method: Follow the main route into the forest and take the purple pickup on the right. Give it to Wu Gang.

collectibles.name: Oil Lamp
collectibles.location: Mort Grotto: short bridge directly before the shrine
collectibles.method: Collect the pickup on the floor and give it to Wu Gang.

collectibles.name: Black Coral Bracelet
collectibles.location: Cloudspire City: tunnel behind boxes before the first ladder
collectibles.method: Enter the house after the shrine, break the boxes on the narrow passage’s right, and take the pickup in the hidden tunnel. Give it to Wu Gang.

collectibles.name: Used Mortar
collectibles.location: Shaft Entrance: before the large corruption spider
collectibles.method: Drop right from the swinging-club path and collect the purple pickup before the spider. Give it to Wu Gang.

collectibles.name: Bronze Armor
collectibles.location: Avian Marsh: nests beyond the tree village
collectibles.method: After leaving the Despair cave and tree village, ignore the shortcut ladder. Follow the left route toward the fighting bird enemies and collect the pickup near the rear nests. Give it to Wu Gang.

collectibles.name: Tome of Silver-Seeking
collectibles.location: Zhenwu Antechamber: second tower’s outer spike walkway
collectibles.method: Descend the shrine’s stairs and cross the towers to the cannon courtyard. Leave left, climb the ladder after the fire bird, and cross to the second tower. Take the pickup beyond the second floor-spike section and give it to Wu Gang.

collectibles.name: Gilded Axe
collectibles.location: Palace Entrance: uphill path to the shrine’s right
collectibles.method: Collect the pickup behind the mouth enemy emerging from the ground and give it to Wu Gang.

collectibles.name: Giant Bronze Arrow
collectibles.location: Capital Entrance: land between the pools right of the white tree
collectibles.method: Enter the cave behind and left of the shrine, then ride the elevator down. Search right of the tall white tree near the fighting monsters, before the grey bird at the gate. Give the arrow to Wu Gang.

guide.context: Finish Worship’s Rise before the Storyteller’s Zhenwu Altar teleport removes it. Agree to help him in ruined Annalum to keep Bo Capital open. Complete the Elder’s quest under Eternal Glory – Zhao Yun’s Spirit for Tomb; the final wrong riddle answer is required for Shrine Dwelling.

collectibles.name: Reverent Temple
collectibles.location: Starting area beyond the opening building
collectibles.method: Use the shrine on the main route.

collectibles.name: Buddha Cliffs
collectibles.location: Above the mountain scaffolding
collectibles.method: Climb the scaffolding on the main route and activate the shrine.

collectibles.name: Lightzen Temple
collectibles.location: Village after Tang Palace Maid
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine on the main route.

collectibles.name: Shu Sanctum
collectibles.location: Large red temple above Lightzen Temple
collectibles.method: Defeat Dhutanga, unlock the gate opposite Lightzen Temple with his key, and follow the uphill path to the shrine.

collectibles.name: Annalum
collectibles.location: Hidden route left of the fire bird near Lu Hongliu
collectibles.method: From Shu Sanctum, cross the invisible bridge and follow the riverside bamboo forest uphill through the village. Cross the roofs beside the boulder thrower; descend left at the fire bird to the shrine.

collectibles.name: Mercury Workshop
collectibles.location: Passage beneath Shu Sanctum
collectibles.method: Defeat Lu Bingzhang and use his key on the lever opposite Shu Sanctum’s shrine. Descend the opened stairs and follow the passage.

collectibles.name: Bandit Cave
collectibles.location: Cave route after Mercury Workshop
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine along the cave route.

collectibles.name: Doomwillow Beach
collectibles.location: Path leaving Bandit Cave
collectibles.method: Defeat the shrine mimic, then activate the real shrine.

collectibles.name: Lu Mansion
collectibles.location: Burned village uphill from Doomwillow Beach
collectibles.method: Turn back at Doomwillow Beach and follow the uphill path slightly right. Activate the shrine by the elevator on the village’s left.

collectibles.name: Corpse Pits
collectibles.location: Exit from Soulwood’s arena
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine after defeating Soulwood.

collectibles.name: Palace Hill
collectibles.location: Top of the ladder beyond Tang Emperor’s Palace
collectibles.method: Climb the ladder on the main route and use the shrine.

collectibles.name: Lotus Pond
collectibles.location: Commander Honglan’s drained arena
collectibles.method: After Honglan sends you to Reverent Temple, return to her arena and activate the new shrine.

collectibles.name: Hillswatch
collectibles.location: Cloudspire entrance beyond Reverent Temple’s courtyard door
collectibles.method: After Commander Honglan, unlock the courtyard door and follow the tunnel to the shrine.

collectibles.name: Snowy Passage
collectibles.location: Beyond Hillswatch village and the archer
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine after leaving the village.

collectibles.name: Cloudspire Outskirts
collectibles.location: Snowy village beside the corruption pillar
collectibles.method: Take the left route after Snowy Passage, open the wooden gate, and climb the courtyard’s left path.

collectibles.name: Mort Grotto
collectibles.location: Cave off Snowy Passage’s right-hand route
collectibles.method: Follow the right cave route from Snowy Passage and activate the shrine.

collectibles.name: Rebel Camp
collectibles.location: Above the two cannon soldiers at the camp’s end
collectibles.method: Follow the uphill buildings from Cloudspire Outskirts or the caves from Mort Grotto. Climb the short ladder beyond the cannons.

collectibles.name: Snowpeak Pass
collectibles.location: Ming General Liu Cheng’en’s arena
collectibles.method: Defeat the boss and activate the shrine that appears.

collectibles.name: Cloudspire City
collectibles.location: End of the first approach to the city
collectibles.method: Continue through the military camp from Snowpeak Pass and activate the shrine on the right.

collectibles.name: Snowfall Palace
collectibles.location: Main route beyond Cloudspire City
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine after leaving the city.

collectibles.name: Treasure Trove
collectibles.location: Huang Yan’s arena
collectibles.method: Defeat Huang Yan and activate the shrine that appears.

collectibles.name: Shaft Entrance
collectibles.location: Below the Treasure Trove elevator
collectibles.method: Ride the elevator down and activate the shrine.

collectibles.name: Bride’s Boudoir
collectibles.location: Main route beyond Shaft Entrance
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine before Fang Ling’s area.

collectibles.name: Wedding Hall
collectibles.location: Fang Ling’s arena
collectibles.method: Defeat Fang Ling and activate the shrine that appears.

collectibles.name: Battlefield Pass
collectibles.location: Mt. Zhenwu tunnel exit
collectibles.method: After Fang Ling, speak to the Storyteller at Wedding Hall. Enter the tunnel he sends you to and follow it to the shrine.

collectibles.name: Refugee Camp
collectibles.location: Hill at the rear of the camp
collectibles.method: From Battlefield Pass, pass the Despair cave and descend the ladder into the camp. Climb the rear hill to the shrine.

collectibles.name: Avian Dwelling
collectibles.location: Right side of the forest below Refugee Camp
collectibles.method: Climb down the ladder at the camp entrance and keep right through the forest.

collectibles.name: Avian Marsh
collectibles.location: First building below the forest’s central ladder
collectibles.method: From the forest below Refugee Camp, follow the middle route down the ladder and enter the first building on the right.

collectibles.name: Zhenwu Antechamber
collectibles.location: Above the far end of Main Rebel Camp
collectibles.method: Reach the camp from Bo Sorcerer’s exit or Refugee Camp’s upper exit. Open the door at the far end and climb the stairs.

collectibles.name: Pavilion of Knowledge
collectibles.location: Cave after the moving-bridge towers
collectibles.method: After Liu Wenxiu, cross the tower route and activate the shrine beside the Storyteller.

collectibles.name: Altar Gate
collectibles.location: Before Zhang Xianzhong’s arena
collectibles.method: Follow the main path from Pavilion of Knowledge and activate the shrine.

collectibles.name: Zhenwu Altar
collectibles.location: Zhang Xianzhong’s arena
collectibles.method: Defeat the boss and activate the shrine. Leave the Storyteller alone until you finish Ferry Overlook and Bai Mansion.

collectibles.name: Ferry Overlook
collectibles.location: Cave behind the Storyteller at Zhenwu Altar
collectibles.method: Walk past the Storyteller without speaking and enter the cave to reach the shrine.

collectibles.name: Bai Mansion
collectibles.location: Across the water from Ferry Overlook
collectibles.method: Take the boat from Ferry Overlook and activate the shrine.

collectibles.name: Rivulet
collectibles.location: Bai Kru’s arena
collectibles.method: Defeat Bai Kru and activate the shrine that appears.

collectibles.name: Annalum
collectibles.location: Arrival point after the Storyteller’s teleport
collectibles.method: After finishing the first three regions, speak to the Storyteller at Zhenwu Altar and activate the shrine at your destination.

collectibles.name: Shu Sanctum
collectibles.location: Ruined version of the original red temple
collectibles.method: Follow the region’s main route to the temple and activate its shrine.

collectibles.name: Annalum Courtyard
collectibles.location: Across the invisible hilltop bridge
collectibles.method: Climb from Shu Sanctum’s roof past the boulder thrower. Keep climbing and cross the invisible bridge to the shrine.

collectibles.name: Palace Vegetable Garden
collectibles.location: Beyond the yellow gate above the palace
collectibles.method: From Shu Sanctum’s roof, climb past the boulder thrower and descend right to the palace. Climb the left stairs behind the yellow statue and open the Benediction Gate to reach the shrine.

collectibles.name: Palace Pass
collectibles.location: Wooded path behind the palace’s fighting monsters
collectibles.method: Exit the palace past the monsters and continue through the small wood to the shrine.

collectibles.name: Palace Entrance
collectibles.location: Red gate beyond Vermilion Feathers Honglan
collectibles.method: Defeat Honglan and pass through the gate that appears to reach the shrine.

collectibles.name: Bo Shrine
collectibles.location: Bo Magus’s arena
collectibles.method: Agree to help the Storyteller in Annalum before defeating Bo Magus. Defeat her and activate the shrine; refusing the Storyteller ends the run here instead.

collectibles.name: Reverent Temple
collectibles.location: Temple reached through the bamboo forest from Shu Sanctum
collectibles.method: Turn back from Shu Sanctum and follow the forest route to the shrine.

collectibles.name: Burning Cavern
collectibles.location: Opening cave above Reverent Temple
collectibles.method: Leave through the temple’s top floor and follow the path to the cave shrine.

collectibles.name: Capital Entrance
collectibles.location: Arrival point after Zhu Youjian
collectibles.method: Defeat Zhu Youjian and activate the shrine where you arrive.

collectibles.name: Depths of the Capital
collectibles.location: Beyond the long elevator on Capital Entrance’s left route
collectibles.method: Follow the shrine’s left route, ride the long elevator, and pass the two fighting monsters to the shrine on the left.

collectibles.name: Tomb
collectibles.location: Return to the white-flower tomb near Avian Dwelling
collectibles.method: Complete the White-Robed Elder’s quest and return after reaching Bo Capital. Defeat Zhao Yun and activate the shrine in his arena.

collectibles.name: Shrine Dwelling
collectibles.location: Hidden destination of the final riddle’s wrong answer
collectibles.method: At Depths of the Capital, choose “The wheel turns anew” at the red gate and activate the shrine in the secret area.

collectibles.name: The Forbidden Lands
collectibles.location: Main route before Xuanyangzi’s arena
collectibles.method: Finish Bo Capital’s main route and activate the shrine before the boss door.

collectibles.name: Gate of Truth
collectibles.location: Xuanyangzi’s final arena
collectibles.method: Defeat Xuanyangzi and activate the new shrine before using the ending gate.
